question: Which among the following rulers adopted the title devaputra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kushana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kushana** adopted the title **devaputra,** which means** "son of god".**
 
• Kushanas were a **Central Asian dynasty** that ruled over parts of South Asia during the **1st to 3rd centuries CE.**
 
• The title **devaputra **was used to signify the **divine status of the ruler** and their connection to the gods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hoyasala **was a **South Indian dynasty** that ruled over parts of **Karnataka** during the 10th to 14th centuries CE.
 
• **Chola **was a South Indian dynasty that ruled over parts of **Tamil Nadu **during the 9th to 13th centuries CE. 
 
• **Saka** were a **Central Asian dynasty** that ruled over parts of **South Asia **during the 2nd century BCE to 4th century CE.
